calibrate.actualHint: The real odometer at the time of the latest GPS reading. The offset is this value minus that reading.
calibrate.help: Choose how GPS distance maps to this vehicle's odometer. Readings from now on are shifted by the offset and can only raise the odometer.
calibrate.offsetHint: Kilometres added to the GPS distance to get the odometer. May be negative.
calibrate.title: Calibrate {{registration_number}}

empty.noLinks: No vehicles are linked to a telematics device yet.

help.intro: Vehicles linked to a telematics device (OptiRadar). A device that reports a real odometer updates the vehicle directly. GPS distance is only kept as a reading until the link is calibrated against the odometer recorded here; after that it can only raise the odometer, never lower it.
